description: This file defines an Android live wallpaper that renders a rotating wireframe cube with touch interaction. It includes a main service class 'CubeWallpaper1' extending 'WallpaperService' and an inner 'CubeEngine' class that handles drawing, surface management, and user input.

classes.name: CubeWallpaper1
classes.description: Main Android live wallpaper service that creates and manages the live wallpaper engine.

classes.name: CubeEngine
classes.description: Inner class extending 'WallpaperService.Engine' responsible for rendering the animated wireframe cube and handling user interactions.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the wallpaper service is destroyed.

methods.name: onCreateEngine
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the cube engine.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the engine, enables touch events.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Removes callbacks when the engine is destroyed.

methods.name: onVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Handles visibility changes, controls animation playback.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Adjusts drawing parameters when the surface size changes.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Handles setup when the surface is created.

methods.name: onSurfaceDestroyed
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the surface is destroyed.

methods.name: onOffsetsChanged
methods.description: Handles offset changes, e.g., when home screen pages shift.

methods.name: drawFrame
methods.description: Renders one frame of the animation and schedules the next.

methods.name: drawLine
methods.description: Draws a 3D line transformed and projected onto 2D.

methods.name: drawTouchPoint
methods.description: Draws a circle at the touch point if available.
